verses.text: Then the LORD spoke to Jonah a second time:
"Get up and go to the great city of Nineveh, and give it the message I give you."
This time Jonah obeyed the LORD and went to Nineveh. Nineveh was a very large city. It took three days to walk through it.
On the first day, Jonah began walking through the city and announcing, "Forty more days, and Nineveh will be destroyed!"
The people of Nineveh believed God. They announced a fast, and all of them, from the most important to the least important, put on rough cloth.
When the news reached the king of Nineveh, he got up from his throne, took off his royal robe, covered himself with rough cloth, and sat down in the ashes.
Then he sent out this order through Nineveh: "By the order of the king and his nobles: No person or animal, no herd or flock, may taste anything. They must not eat or drink water.
People and animals must be covered with rough cloth. Everyone must pray hard to God. Let everyone turn from their evil ways and from the violence they do.
Who knows? God may change his mind and turn away from his fierce anger, so that we will not die."
When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he changed his mind. He did not bring on them the disaster he had threatened.
